'''Ōtori Shrine''' (大鷲神社, also pronounced Ōwashi Shrine) refers to a name for various {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} across Japan. These shrines are part of the {{ill|Ōtori faith|ja|大鳥信仰}}, with {{ill|Ōtori taisha|abstract|Q705151|fr|Ōtori-taisha|ja|大鳥大社|my|အိုးတိုရိနတ်ကွန်း နန်းရင်း|zh|大鳥大社|qid=Q705151|lt=Ōtori taisha}} as their main shrine. Many are related to other shrines with similar names, such as {{ill|Ōtori Shrine|ja|大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|qid=Q65258929|lt=Ōtori Shrine (disambiguation)}}, {{ill|Washi Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|鷲神社|qid=Q11676283}}, and {{ill|Washi-no-Miya Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|鷲宮神社 (曖昧さ回避)|qid=Q65293873}}. Several are also widely known for hosting {{ill|Tori-no-Ichi|ja|酉の市|1=Tori-no-Ichi|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tori-no-Ichi|13=User:Immanuelle/Tori-no-Ichi|qq=}} festivals. There are seven such shrines officially recognized as religious corporations nationwide.

For related terms, see {{ill|Ōtori Shrine|ja|大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|qid=Q65258929|lt=Ōtori Shrine (disambiguation)}}, {{ill|Washi Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|鷲神社|qid=Q11676283}}, {{ill|Washi-no-Miya Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|鷲宮神社 (曖昧さ回避)|qid=Q65293873}}, and {{ill|Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|日鷲神社}}.

* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Tsukuba)|ja|大鷲神社 (つくば市)}} - Located in Tedegaki, Tsukuba City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Ichikawa)|ja|大鷲神社 (市川市)}} - Located in Takaya, Ichikawa City, Chiba Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Ichihara)|ja|大鷲神社 (市原市)}} - Located in Yanagihara, Ichihara City, Chiba Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Narita)|ja|大鷲神社 (成田市)}} - Located in Kitahatori, Narita City, Chiba Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Sakae)|ja|大鷲神社 (栄町)}} - Located in Anjō, Sakae Town, Inba District, Chiba Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Shisui)|ja|大鷲神社 (酒々井町)}} - Located in Kamiiwahashi, Shisui Town, Inba District, Chiba Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Adachi Ward)|ja|大鷲神社 (足立区)|lt=Ōtori Shrine (Adachi)}} - Located in Hanahata, Adachi Ward, Tokyo. Known as the origin of Tori-no-Ichi.
* Ōtori Shrine - Located in Miyamachi, Fuchū City, Tokyo. A subsidiary shrine of {{ill|Ōkunitama Shrine|en|Ōkunitama Shrine|qid=Q611678|lt=Ōkunitama Shrine}}.
* Ōtori Shrine - Located in Makane-chō, Minami Ward, Yokohama City, Kanagawa Prefecture. Consolidated into the precincts of a {{ill|Kotohira shrines|ja|金刀比羅神社|lt=Konpira Shrine}} (see {{ill|Konpira and Ōtori Shrine|ja|金刀比羅・大鷲神社}}).
